div.head: VI Atr 28.3
div.ab: ⁊ deoflice dæda on morðweorcum ⁊ on manslihtan, on stalan ⁊ on strudungan, on gitsungan ⁊ on gifernessan, on ofermettan ⁊ on oferfyllan, on swiccræftan ⁊ on mistlican lahbrican, on æwbrican ⁊ on hadbrican, on freolsbricon ⁊ on fæstenbricon, on cyricrénan ⁊ on mæniges cynnes misdædan.

⁊ deoflice dæda on morðweorcum ⁊ on manslihtan, on stalan ⁊ on strudungan, on gitsungan ⁊ on gifernessan, on ofermettan ⁊ on oferfyllan, on swiccræftan ⁊ on mistlican lahbrican, on æwbrican ⁊ on hadbrican, on freolsbricon ⁊ on fæstenbricon, on cyricrénan ⁊ on mæniges cynnes misdædan.

and deoflice dæda on morðweorcum and on manslihtan, on stalan and on strudungan, on gitsungan and on gifernessan, on ofermettan and on oferfyllan, on swiccræftan and on mistlican lahbrican, on æwbrican and on hadbrican, on freolsbricon and on fæstenbricon, on cyricrenan and on mæniges cynnes misdædan.

und teuflische Thaten, bestehend in Mordthaten und Todtschlägen, in Diebstählen und Räubereien, in Geiz und Gier, in Fressereien und Völlereien, in Truglisten und verschiedentlichen Rechtsverletzungen, in Ehebrüchen und Klerusverletzungen, in Feiertagsverletzungen und Fastenbrüchen, in Kirchenberaubungen und Missethaten mancherlei Art.

and devilish deeds, consisting in murders and manslaughters, in thefts and robberies, in avarice and greed, in gluttony and drunkenness, in frauds and various breaches of law, in adulteries and violations of holy orders, in breaches of feast-days and of fasts, in robbing churches, and in misdeeds of many kinds.

and shameful frauds, and foul adulteries, and horrible perjuries, and devilish deeds such as murders and homicides, thefts and robberies, covetousness and greed, gluttony and intemperance, frauds and various breaches of the law, violations of marriage and of holy orders, breaches of festivals and of fasts, sacrilege, and misdeeds of many kinds.

likewise, devilish deeds, such as murder and manslaughter, theft and robbery, avarice and cupidity, gluttony and overindulgence, treachery and countless violations of the law, of marriage vows, of holy orders, of feasts and fasts, of church property, and misdeeds of many kinds.

note.seg: Das Kompositum kennt Toller nur hierher; Sweet Dict. liest dafür -rán; vgl. Gl Kirchenraub 1
Toller knows the compound only from this passage; Sweet Dict. reads -rán instead; cf. Gl Kirchenraub 1
Die hinzugefügten Vergehen sind fast lauter geistliche: bezeichnend für des Lateiners Sinn; s. o. Einl. 19
The offences added are almost all ecclesiastical: characteristic of the Latin translator’s outlook; see above Introduction 19
This phrase occurs only in MS G₂ of V Atr.
This is the only instance of the word cyricren quoted in BT., see p. 189; Suppl., p. 125.
The Latin paraphrase adds rixae, dissensiones, blasphemiae, necromantiae, idolatriae.
